entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Look, that must be Kuniko Kagami!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Let's change her heart, for her child!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Kuniko Kagami. You are the mother who[n]doesn't properly care for her children,[n]correct?

entries.speaker: Shadow Kagami
entries.en: My children...? The Phantom Thieves...?

entries.speaker: Shadow Kagami
entries.en: I know... I really do. I know that you're right,[n]but I can't...

entries.speaker: Shadow Kagami
entries.en: Please, leave me alone... I don't deserve to[n]live...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: ...Something is wrong with her.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Could this be what people call... self-neglect?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Not being able to sustain a normal life to the[n]point where it's damaging to their health...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I remember the request saying something[n]about the room being messy!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: So not only was she neglecting her children,[n]but herself as well!?

entries.speaker: Shadow Kagami
entries.en: My father and mother died one after[n]another... Then my husband died too...

entries.speaker: Shadow Kagami
entries.en: Everyone who supported me is dead...

entries.speaker: Shadow Kagami
entries.en: I have no reason to live anymore...!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That's not true. What about your child?

entries.speaker: Shadow Kagami
entries.en: My child...

entries.speaker: Shadow Kagami
entries.en: No... Leave me alone. I don't need anyone's[n]help!

entries.speaker: Shadow Kagami
entries.en: My child would be happier to die with me![n]I have to take her with me...!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: That's wrong...!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Joker, we have to stop her!

entries.speaker: Shadow Kagami
entries.en: Shut up, shut up, shut up! Stay away from[n]me!

entries.speaker: Shadow Kagami
entries.en: When all of my family members started[n]passing away, I didn't know what to do...

entries.speaker: Shadow Kagami
entries.en: I lost the will to do anything. I couldn't[n]even get out of bed on some days...

entries.speaker: Shadow Kagami
entries.en: I was even annoyed by my daughter when[n]she would talk to me... I wished for her[n]death...!

entries.speaker: Shadow Kagami
entries.en: How could I think of something so[n]horrible...!
You didn't do anything yet.
It's not too late to change.

entries.speaker: Shadow Kagami
entries.en: Oh...

entries.speaker: Shadow Kagami
entries.en: You're right...

entries.speaker: Shadow Kagami
entries.en: I haven't done anything yet... It's not too[n]late to take care of her...

entries.speaker: Shadow Kagami
entries.en: Oh...

entries.speaker: Shadow Kagami
entries.en: You're right...

entries.speaker: Shadow Kagami
entries.en: If it's not too late...

entries.speaker: Shadow Kagami
entries.en: Right now, I just want to go home and hug[n]her.

entries.speaker: Shadow Kagami
entries.en: And... I'm gonna start changing by doing[n]what I can.
